overview.no_rooms: No light zones yet. Add one to switch its lights with presence and daylight.
rooms.intro: A light zone is a group of lights with its presence sensors and settings; the zones of an area form a room. Open a zone to change its settings, see what each light adds to the light sensor and adjust the presence sensors.
confirm.delete_text: Bright Rooms stops switching the lights of this light zone and forgets what it learned about them. The lights and sensors are not touched.
confirm.measure_text: The value is forgotten and learned again the next times the light is switched with little daylight. Until then the ambient light of the zone is held while this light is on.
editor.not_found: This light zone does not exist any more.
editor.form_unavailable: The form cannot be shown: reload the page.
editor.hint_area: A light zone is a group of lights with its own presence sensors, in a room (a Home Assistant area); a room can have several zones. Bright Rooms switches only the lights chosen below.
editor.hint_daylight: The ambient light is the sensor's reading minus what the zone's own lights add, so a lamp is never taken for daylight. The other lights below matter only for measuring how much each lamp adds: a change of one of them during a measurement discards it.
editor.hint_off: When nobody is left, the lights wait, dim as a warning, then turn off. Nearby presence makes them wait longer.
contrib.title: Contributions
contrib.hint: Lux each light adds to the light sensor at full brightness. Learned when the light is switched with little daylight; you can also type a value.

settings.hint_learning: How Bright Rooms learns what each light adds to the light sensor. They apply to every light zone.

help.name: A room (area) can have several light zones, for example the cooktop and the table of a kitchen, each with its own presence sensor.
help.presence_sensors: The zone is occupied when at least one is on.
help.zone_sensors: Other presence sensors that count as nearby presence.
help.lights: The lights Bright Rooms switches. A light can belong to one light zone only.
help.illuminance_sensor: Without it the zone always counts as dark.
help.other_lights: Lights of other rooms, or not managed by Bright Rooms, that the sensor sees: if one changes during a measurement, the measurement is discarded.
help.on_delay: Continuous presence needed before turning on.
help.only_when_dark: Off: the lights turn on at every arrival.
help.bright_above: Must be higher than the dark threshold.
help.off_when_bright: Turns the lights off when daylight comes, even with people in the zone.
help.on_when_dark: With someone already in the zone and every light off, turns the lights on when dusk comes. Only with "Turn on only when dark".
help.min_off_seconds: For lamps that change tint when switched quickly.
help.brightness_min: Dimmable lights: brightness at or below the dark level; 100 = always full.
help.brightness_full_lux: Full brightness at or above this ambient light, linear in between.
help.zone_wait: Maximum extra wait while there is nearby presence.
help.dim_percent: Dimmable lights are dimmed to this share of their brightness before turning off; 100 = no dimming.
help.dim_wait: How long the lights stay dimmed before turning off.
help.transition: Fade of the final turn-off of dimmable lights.
help.settle_seconds: After a light changes, the ambient light is held this long: light sensors report late and some lamps ramp up.
help.learn_ambient_max: Contributions are measured only with little daylight.
help.learn_min_previous: A light switched again sooner is not measured.
help.learn_weight: How much a new measurement moves the learned value (0–1).
